software_class: catalog, transaction, booking, or multi-party commerce workflow

options.name: Managed commerce platform integration
options.when_to_use: Standard catalog, checkout, and order flows fit the scope.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when transaction rules are highly custom.
options.rationale: Reduces payment and order infrastructure burden.
options.risks: Platform constraints can shape product behavior too much.

options.name: Custom transaction application
options.when_to_use: Workflow rules, roles, or booking states are unique.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when managed commerce covers the need.
options.rationale: Gives full control over domain logic.
options.tradeoffs: Requires stronger security and operational design.
options.risks: Transaction edge cases can expand scope quickly.

options.name: Catalog plus request flow
options.when_to_use: Users browse options but final commitment happens offline or manually.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when self-service checkout is required.
options.rationale: Keeps scope lightweight while preserving discovery.
options.risks: Conversion metrics can be harder to attribute.
